rows.notes: no open bulk download found (2026-08): MHD requires an application (CSU Chico), mayacorpus.org (200k+ glyph blocks, MHD-sourced) is interactive-only, TWKM/Bonn publishes no public TEI dump — contact the projects; see docs/data_gaps.md
